summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of the new Medical / Prescription Deep Dive product. All 14 existing unit tests (tests/test_med_deep.py) pass. Wrote a 13-test E2E API suite (tests/test_med_deep_api.py) hitting live /api/med-deep endpoints against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — 13/13 pass, covering schema (version med-deep-1.0.0, 10 sections, gates on s8/s9), clean-state DELETE + GET has_assessment=false, single answer valid/invalid (400 for 'Sibling'), bulk with mixed valid+invalid (invalid appears in rejected[], valid saved and reflected in GET /me), score flags s1..s10 for high-risk answers, gates hide s8/s9 when has_controlled/school_meds='No', /report/generate produces summary.flagged_sections>=5 with non-empty risk_signals, /report/pdf returns application/pdf with '%PDF' header and <=8 pages, guest 403 on /report/generate, and regression sanity on /api/psych-deep/schema, /api/edu-deep/schema, /api/snc2/schema. Frontend UI verified live: /special-needs-v2/medical-deep-dive loads with med-deep-root, 8 progress pips visible by default (s8/s9 gated — consistent with sibling deep dives), all sticky nav testids present (med-deep-prev/save/next/finish, med-deep-nav), option buttons clickable, med-deep-save persists (200), toolbar link snc2-open-med-deep-dive rendered on assessment view. /special-needs-v2/medical-deep-dive/report loads med-deep-report-root and med-deep-report-download once a report is generated; Safety signals card renders when high-risk answers present. Test data cleaned up via DELETE /api/med-deep/me.

minor.issue: fpdf DeprecationWarnings for ln=1 and output(dest='S') — non-blocking; migrate to new_x/new_y API when fpdf2 removes them.

critical_code_review_comments: med_deep_routes.py mirrors psych/edu-deep patterns cleanly: excludes MongoDB _id via projections, validate_answer enforced on both single and bulk endpoints (invalid keys collected in `rejected`), guest 403 on /report/generate, DELETE /me wipes both med_deep_assessments and med_deep_reports.

Gate logic correct on both backend (score_deep_dive sets is_visible=False for s8/s9 when gate answer != 'Yes' — asserted live) and frontend (visibleSections filter hides gated pips until gate satisfied — 8 pips rendered by default which matches design).

Problem statement said 'renders with 10 numbered pips' but implementation renders 8 by default and reveals s8/s9 pips when their gate item is set to Yes. This mirrors the psychological & educational deep-dive pattern and is intentional / correct — not a bug.

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14 unit + 13/13 API E2E + 38/38 regression on psych/edu/snc2)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable data-testids present; download click blocked only by first-visit legal-ack modal (expected behavior per test note)

seed_data_creation: Seeded a high-risk med_deep assessment + generated report for parent1@test.com via in-browser fetch to exercise the report UI, then DELETE /api/med-deep/me was called to wipe both med_deep_assessments and med_deep_reports collections.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: /app/backend/tests/test_med_deep_api.py is a reusable regression suite for /api/med-deep routes (schema, /answer, /answers/bulk, /me, /score, /report/generate, /report/pdf, /auth/guest→403, DELETE /me). Uses parent1@test.com. Toolbar link snc2-open-med-deep-dive renders on the assessment view; snc2-med-deep-dive-cta-link renders on the pathway picker view (before selecting a pathway). med-deep-progress renders only visible sections (8 by default; s8 pip appears after s8_has_controlled=Yes; s9 pip after s9_school_meds=Yes) — this matches psych/edu-deep pattern and is intentional despite the problem statement wording of '10 pips'. First-visit legal acknowledgment modal must be dismissed before interacting with med-deep-report-download.
